_note: claude-code exposes four user-facing transport types in settings JSON: stdio, sse, http, ws. InProcess and SdkControl are internal-only and never round-trip through user/project/managed settings; SseIde/WsIde (oracle sse-ide/ws-ide) are members of the PLUGIN mcpServers union `KY` but are ABSENT from the settings/.mcp.json config table `ZGn` (mcp §10 in the byte-alignment doc), so they never round-trip through user/project/managed settings either. PosixMcpTransport::connect() must accept Stdio/Sse/Http specs (WebSocket is wired via the dedicated `connect_ws` helper rather than the trait method in v0.3.0); InProcess, SdkControl, SseIde and WsIde must yield McpError::UnsupportedTransport from production transports. The fixture documents the categorisation; the driver below builds each spec variant programmatically and asserts the production transport's response.
